column1: # What enforces each requirement in this library's specs (0024-spec-format FR-011 - FR-014).
# mechanism: check | gate | review | none. by: "<repo>: <command>" for check and gate, the defining requirement for review, "-" for none.

column4: note
suite/layers.test.ts: every file of the real tree is in a unit and a file in none is layers/unclassified
suite/layers.test.ts: below may not import above and each unit imports only what its row allows
suite/layers.test.ts: the package exports the library and its layers
suite/layers.test.ts: verify runs every check of the library
suite/layers.test.ts: the release record agrees with the manifest and the package
suite/layers.test.ts: no source imports a module that reads a file, reaches the network or runs a program
suite/governance.test.ts: tool names and versions are made only by their functions and compared by their numbers
suite/governance.test.ts: a tool is defined or refused with every reason
suite/governance.test.ts: the pin policy and the minimum
suite/governance.test.ts: an artifact has an https address with no credentials, a SHA-256, a format and a folder inside
suite/governance.test.ts: a tool has bindings and no duplicate binding
suite/governance.test.ts: no secret in the environment or the program
suite/governance.test.ts: a catalog refuses duplicates, missing needs, cycles and a program provided twice, and is in order of needs
suite/logical.test.ts: a dialect declares its guarantees as data
suite/logical.test.ts: meetsIntegrity names every reason a dialect does not meet the control
suite/logical.test.ts: resolveTools picks the first dialect that can, in the order of needs
suite/logical.test.ts: a tool no dialect can carry out is refused with every reason, and a source-building dialect is never chosen
suite/logical.test.ts: planTools says none, install or replace, and counts a path copy only where policy allows
suite/logical.test.ts: requirementsFor gives requirements of kind tool that an order of archon is built from
suite/governance.test.ts: a tool holds no version or hash of a pin, only the id of the pin
suite/logical.test.ts: the downloads come from a PinSource, a pin with no download or a version below the minimum is a reason, and the library does not read the ontology
suite/governance.test.ts: other names of a program, refused where they clash
suite/ontology.test.ts: a download for a pinned program on a platform
suite/ontology.test.ts: the ontology's reason for an unknown, unpinned or not pinned download
suite/ontology.test.ts: every download given is valid under defineDownload
suite/ontology.test.ts: no version, address or hash in the sources
